title: Maine Revised Statutes Title 35-A - Public Utilities
source_id: 35-A M.R.S. (esp. Part 1, ch. 3, Rates of Public Utilities; ch. 27, Inspection of Meters and Civil Liability)
verified_how: Fetched title35-Ach0sec0.html, which prints 'Title 35-A: PUBLIC UTILITIES' and lists Part 1 Public Utilities Commission (ch. 3 Rates of Public Utilities, ch. 13 Procedure, ch. 15 Sanctions and Administrative Penalties), Part 2 Public Utilities (ch. 27 Inspection of Meters and Civil Liability), Part 3 Electric Power, Part 4 Gas, Part 6 Water (ch. 61 General Provisions and Rates), Part 7 Telecommunications (ch. 73 Telephone Rates). Data extracted 10/20/2025; text current through October 1, 2025.
notes: The statute sets rate-making, metering and Commission jurisdiction; the operative consumer billing, deposit, arrears and disconnection rules are made by the Public Utilities Commission by rule (Chapter 815, Consumer Protection Standards for Electric and Gas Transmission and Distribution Utilities) rather than by statute - so the everyday billing entitlements are regulation, not statute, in Maine.
